sources.quote: HD 49674 is a solar-type star with an exoplanetary companion in the northern constellation of Auriga.

introduction.text: Gaia's parallax, brightness and spectrum give it 1.0 solar radii and 0.91 solar masses (FLAME) and 5,592 K at its surface (GSP-Phot).
